text: Best speech-to-text on mobile, by far. It picks the word that fits (bear/bare, where/wear), lets me fix things mid-sentence, and follows instructions like "send it to AIB, (aib in all caps)." Bullet lists and line breaks just happen (implicitly and explicitly). The floating bubble means I keep my Gboard features too. fun fact, In May I emailed asking for that bubble and they actually built it! A company that listens to its users. 5 stars. Worth $12/m.
